resources.string: Assumed filling percentage of the cycle
Whole cycle (ms) = 60,000 ÷ heart rate (bpm). Simulated filling time = whole cycle × (filling percentage ÷ 100).

In a normally beating human heart, blood flows from the atria into the ventricles during filling. This simulation assumes a steady heart rate. The filling percentage is a share of time chosen independently, not a prediction from heart rate or a share of blood volume. The model does not predict filling in any individual or estimate cardiac output.
